dataset.selection: First distinct prompt IDs encountered in each pinned tar archive, before inference; not random, not a full test-set score.

normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, punctuation removed, apostrophes preserved; no number expansion. CER excludes spaces.
timing: One run per clip/model, including per-call loading. Model order rotated. Cached inference timings retained on rerun. Not a warm throughput benchmark.
scope: ASR components on public read speech. Whisper/MLX is a legacy-model proxy, not a rerun of V1/Vibe. Parakeet equals the unreviewed V2 selected text; Qwen is a separate candidate. No meeting WER, DER, identity or human-time claim.
package_version_during_run: 0.1.0 with the new evaluation runner in the working tree
provenance_note: The initial runtime fingerprint is retained. Full Core ML artifact hashes and inference package versions were captured immediately after inference, before any inference dependency changes. The published runner includes them in future cache keys.
